api_gateway.description: Fully managed service for creating, publishing, maintaining, monitoring, and securing REST, HTTP, and WebSocket APIs at any scale
api_gateway.use_cases: REST APIs, WebSocket APIs, HTTP APIs, API versioning, request/response transformation
api_gateway.pricing: Pay per API call, free tier: 1M API calls per month

lambda_pricing.description: Pay only for compute time consumed, charged per 100ms of execution
lambda_pricing.free_tier: 1M free requests per month, 400,000 GB-seconds compute time
lambda_pricing.cost_factors: Number of requests, duration, memory allocation

s3_vs_ebs.s3: Object storage, unlimited capacity, accessed via REST API
s3_vs_ebs.ebs: Block storage, attached to EC2 instances, limited capacity
s3_vs_ebs.use_s3_for: Static websites, backups, data lakes, content distribution
s3_vs_ebs.use_ebs_for: Database storage, file systems, boot volumes

serverless_architecture.components: Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, CloudFront
serverless_architecture.benefits: No server management, automatic scaling, pay-per-use

aws_free_tier.12_months_free: EC2 (750 hours t2.micro), S3 (5GB), RDS (750 hours db.t2.micro)
